description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Nos. 1685/5 of 21.12.2010 and 1710/21 of 16.06.2011, Moratuwa D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific amendments to land title particulars for identified parcels of land (No. 51 of Block 02 and No. 97 of Block 01) in the Colombo District, including changes to servitude rights and access details. The content falls under the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration, title amendments, and property rights modifications without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
